headline: One Person Companies: Upgrade From Selling Time To Selling Systems
summary: Discover how to transition from hourly rates to scalable AI services and digital products, achieving up to 98% gross margins.
details: Many one-person companies struggle with trading time for money, earning only 10-30% gross margins. The key to significant income growth lies in productization: transforming services into products, products into subscriptions, and subscriptions into ecosystems. This shift allows for marginal costs to approach zero, dramatically increasing profitability.

The first path, AI-Enabled Service Delivery, involves project-based work like AI copywriting (¥30-100/article) or design (¥50-200/piece). Beginners can earn ¥2,000-4,000 monthly with 1-2 hours daily, reaching ¥5,000+ with experience. However, this level has a hard ceiling, as income growth is directly tied to workload.

Path Two, Selling AI Services, offers a breakthrough by selling capability rather than time. This includes AI Agent customization (¥3,000-50,000 per unit), managed services (¥1,000-5,000/month per client), automation solutions (¥5,000-20,000 per project), and training (¥3,000-15,000 per day). This level can yield ¥10,000-50,000 monthly.

The ultimate path, Selling AI Digital Products, unlocks substantial income, with annual earnings exceeding ¥1 million. Options include AI SaaS tools (¥50,000+/month subscription), AI Agent templates (¥5,000-20,000 per unit, sold infinitely), and knowledge products (courses, communities, coaching) generating ¥500,000-2,000,000 annually. This level boasts 80-98% margins.

To achieve this transformation, focus on three steps: identify high-frequency client needs that appear 50+ times, standardize and templatize these services using AI workflows, and build automated delivery systems. This allows one person to deliver what previously required an entire team, operating 24/7.

By 2026, China's One Person Company (OPC) base is projected to exceed 16 million. The top 2% achieve 80-98% gross margins through productization, while the bottom 80% remain at 10-30% margins. The critical factor is upgrading from selling time to selling systems and automated workflows.

headline_marked: [[Puppet-checkmk module]] updated with support for modern OS
headline: Puppet-checkmk module updated with support for modern OS
summary: The VoxPupuli puppet-checkmk module has been refreshed with updated metadata and support for RedHat-10 and Debian-13.
details: The VoxPupuli puppet-checkmk module, previously hidden from the Puppet Forge due to inactivity, has been updated. Puppet Forge hides modules that haven't seen recent releases, impacting visibility for sysadmins.

To address this, the module's metadata has been refreshed, and its compatibility has been expanded to include modern operating systems like RedHat-10 and Debian-13. This ensures the module remains discoverable and functional for users managing contemporary systems.

The update process involved some challenges, particularly with EPEL repositories on systems like Oracle Linux. These issues have been resolved, ensuring a smoother experience for users integrating the module into their infrastructure.
caption:
